name: V807 Tau

planets.name: Bab
planets.note: long-known triple-system secondary (itself a close pair) re-detected at 0.17" in the non-coronagraphic SPHERE image; no significant disk signal in polarized light (Garufi et al. 2024); Bab undetected at 1.3 mm (Akeson et al. 2019)

images.wavelength_label: H band 1.6 um (companion Bab at 0.17"; no disk signal in polarized light)

paper.title: The SPHERE view of the Taurus star-forming region: The full census of planet-forming disks with GTO and DESTINYS programs

images.wavelength_label: H band; triple resolved - A, Ba, Bb all labeled ('2008 Dec 17' in panel)
images.note: Resolves the held 'Bab' companion into Ba+Bb; figure holds 9 epochs 2002-2011 (more panels available if multi-epoch desired). Complements the held Garufi 2024 DPI record where Bab is unresolved.

paper.title: Orbit and Stellar Properties of the Young Triple V807 Tau

notes: K7 young multiple system in Taurus; the held SPHERE/IRDIS H-band image from the Taurus polarimetric census shows the close companion pair (Bab at 0.17 arcsec), while no significant polarized disk signal is detected (Garufi et al. 2024).
